facts.name: Barry Baker
facts.assignment: Clerk of the Circuit and County Courts and Comptroller.

contact.contact_note: Email is the public-records custodian mailbox, not a personal clerk or case-filing email. Office expressly directs court-case inquiries by phone, not email. Fax from circuit directory; department phones separately labeled.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Office hours8:00am–4:30pm. Contact court-case inquiries by phone; public-records mailbox/request portal is distinct from e-filing.
procedure_checklist.filing: Official site links Florida Courts E-Filing Portal; submitting an email is not represented as filing.

gaps: No personal clerk email or named assistant established; public-records purpose preserved.
No revision/effective date stated on contact and office-hours pages.
facts.review_scope: Official contact, phone directory and office-hours pages plus preserved circuit directory clerk block. General contact/filing routing only; no specialized forms or individual litigation analysis.
facts.summary: Circuit and county clerk contacts with distinct civil-department phone routes; public-records email restricted to its stated purpose.
